store: Pantry dry reserve, Sol 6.1 / extra high
rule: Cook's dry reserve: flour, spice pouches, herbs and processed ingredients. Genuine uncooked foods remain optional; no armour or mould wildcard.
units_split: 40 places x 7 alternative families x 2 stack units; alternatives occupy the same place, so physical inventory capacity is 80, not 560.

frame.atlas_rows: 96-127 hewn, 64-95 end grain, 48-63 iron, 36-47 clay, 24-35 wicker unchanged; 20-23 leather, 16-19 smoky glass, 12-15 r3 linen, 8-11 hessian, 4-7 cord, 0-3 swatches

space: Unity prefab space, metres. Origin: the wall plane (back face, z = 0), x centred, y = 0 the foot; front is +z. Blender z-up/-y front -> Unity: ux=-bx, uy=bz, uz=-by. OBJ exported forward -Z, up Y (the mod loads it flipX).
vessel_meshes_doc: one mesh per family in the same OBJ convention as the frame, in local coordinates: origin = the centre of the vessel's footprint at the shelf surface (vessels[].at); draw it at 'at' (no rotation) with the frame's material. Tris: jar 372, board 124, basket 576, platter 364, crock 464, sack 720.
vessels_doc: Every place draws the vessel of its stored item family. Dry-first defaults are illustration only; empty places draw nothing. Clay is the ordinary spice vessel; only two named spice kinds use smoky glass.
groups: place0..39, two stacks of one kind per place. Family alternatives share that place. Platter/board use r2 clear boxes, basket/sack r3 crowned heaps, and spice/clay use the preserved source layouts.

_generic.note: fallback for any item without its own layout in any vessel: a neutral round lump (a settled heap), scaled uniformly so its longest bounds side is fit_longest_m; it fits every family's clear space.

crop_layouts_doc: The explicit 32 real-item layouts retain r2 transforms for flat optional dishes and spice pouches; r3 crowned transforms are used only for its three matching basket kinds and the two flour kinds. Cupcakes keep the r2 upright grouping on a low platter. The generic entry is an inherited fallback. Rotation/offset conventions and two cumulative stack steps are unchanged.
unit_semantics: units_list: one unit = one stack, 2 per place and family in fill order; kind = the family; copies = the generic lump as Fit.Longest copies (centre at position + offset), a fallback only.
physics: heaps: Blender rigid body (Bullet), each copy the convex hull of its item, friction 0.6, restitution 0, damping 0.5/0.95, margin 1 mm, substeps 20, iterations 40, in the cylinder made of passive box slabs (round vessels only); one copy per kind per drop at one of the three lowest well-supported spots of a 1 cm grid x 8 orientations, settled, checked inside the cylinder, then frozen; until no copy fits or the kind's cap (~5400 item triangles per vessel).

checks.frame_geometry: Source r2 build_frame and seed11, with fitted lip tongues/stiles, timber-backed iron and embedded plaque relief; shelf tops and vessel floor centres retained

frame_contact.author: Sol 6.1 / extra high
frame_contact.limit: Geometric contact graph, including decorative hardware. Ground reachability is inferred from mesh contact and z=0; it does not prove load capacity, stability, fastening strength, or wall anchorage. Embedded-volume links require odd surface crossings in two non-axis-aligned directions; inspect suspect open/nonmanifold meshes independently.

checks.item_layout_provenance: r3 for basket/sack; r2 for all others; transforms reused exactly; original contact/overlap reports remain under crop_layouts.*.check

review_variant.label: Sol 6.1 / extra high
review_variant.status: internal experiment; no runtime integration or release
review_variant.primary_scene: 40 vessels x 2 stacks = 80 occupied inventory slots; dry stock with repeated flour and herbs; not every accepted kind
runtime_followup: Replace broad *Uncooked inclusion with the explicit 12 genuine food prefabs already listed in item_family; keep existing deposits retrievable
Read the added glass family from item_family and retain 80 slots; do not infer inventory capacity from number of family-specific anchors
Dry-demo ordering is an illustration; per-place allocation in the runtime must be checked separately
review_variant.performance_followup: Separate display-only item overrides keep all32 permitted one-kind full inventories below250k triangles. W must implement item_visual_overrides loading before enabling this path. Unchanged game ItemDrop/held/equipped models, quantity and settled positions; no measured FPS claim.
